steps.title: Introduction
steps.body: Hi, I'm [Name] with Sample Peak Roofing. I'm in the neighborhood today because the recent hail storm caused damage to many roofs in this area. Have you had a chance to look at your roof since the storm?
steps.tips: Be friendly and non-pushy. If they have not looked, that is your opening.

steps.title: Damage Assessment
steps.body: I noticed from the street that your roof may have some damage. Would it be okay if I took a quick look from the ground? No obligation at all.
steps.tips: Never go on the roof without permission. Point out damage from the ground.

steps.title: Close
steps.body: I can schedule a free inspection for you this week. What day works best?
steps.tips: Offer specific time slots. Leave a door hanger if they want to think about it.
